_note: 独立通道对账 · 子管线（被 lemeng.recon.preagg 的 foreach 派发，每营业日一次）。
判据：湖侧明细按已对齐口径净化后的净额 vs 网关预聚合端点（nhsoft.report.ai.itemsales.find），逐店 diff。
【取参口径】book/bucket/day/settled/门店清单**全部来自父管线 ITER 行**——foreach 只替 ${ITER_*}，
子管线（尤其 tmp/ 直跑时）不吃 ${ENV:} ⇒ 本文件上下文无关，探针态与工作区态同形。
【口径唯一事实源】scripts/lemeng/recon-preagg.sh 头注：
net(店) = Σ_订单[(Σ非赠品行额 + order_total_money)/2] − Σ分摊折扣，只收 FINISHED + SALE_ORDER；
赠品判别式 = std_price>0 AND sale_money>0 AND qty>0 AND |折扣 − 标价×数量| ≤ 0.02；
逐订单归并**不能省**（按行算会把「总额×行数」加进去）；不扣退货单。本文件 lagg 逐字对应该公式。
【gate ↔ 脚本退出码映射】（判红靠它，与 alerts.json 的 failure/recovery 规则接同一张网）
lguard / gcode  = 脚本 exit 3（依赖不可用）——湖分区空 / 预聚合端点 code≠0
gbranch / gthresh = 脚本 exit 1（判据破）——门店缺 / 差超容差
全静默          = 脚本 exit 0（通过；未定稿日也走这条，只报数不判红）
【为什么先看 envelope（gcode 排在最前）】端点业务失败（如 3120 的恒 10006）是 HTTP 200 +
code≠0，/result/rows 会是空 ⇒ 若不看 envelope 直接比行，会把「依赖坏了」误判成
「全部门店缺失」（假红，且诊断错方向）。rawResponseDestination 落原始报文，
envelope 从字节里抠 code——「对源的疑问从字节答，不靠争」（src.rest 该字段的文档语义）。
【容差】tol = max(1.00, |源合计|×0.01%)（脚本 PREAGG_ABS_TOL / PREAGG_MAX_PCT 同款）。
【两档】settled 由父管线按 T-3 定线传入；violation SQL 恒带 settled=1 条件 ⇒ 未定稿日
两闸恒静默、report 照写 = 「只报数不判红」（脚本 PREAGG_UNSETTLED 同义）。
【产物】/workspace/reports/recon-preagg/recon-<book>-<bizday>.csv（逐店明细，单对象覆盖=幂等）；
owners.lemeng.json 以 *.csv maximumAge 36h 作「没有失败的停更」锚（close.l1 同公式：24h+12h）。
源有而湖无的门店（当日无销售）按脚本同款**只在明细里可见、不判红**。
name: lemeng.recon.preagg.item

data.label: lake T-3 单日零售明细（精确分区）
lmat 物化湖行（控制节点上下文丢 S3 连接配置，先落 TABLE）

properties.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "lmat" AS SELECT * FROM "lake"

data.label: lguard 湖空即死（exit3 语义）

properties.message: recon 依赖不可用（lake_unavailable）：bizday=${ITER_ITEM_BIZDAY} 分区为空——采集未跑或分区缺失

data.label: lagg 湖侧净化净额（逐订单归并，口径=recon-preagg.sh）

properties.sql:
WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT CAST(branch_num AS INTEGER) AS b,
         CAST(order_no AS VARCHAR) AS o,
         sum(CASE WHEN CAST(order_detail_std_price AS DOUBLE) > 0
                    AND CAST(sale_money AS DOUBLE) > 0
                    AND CAST(quantity AS DOUBLE) > 0
                    AND abs(CAST(discount_money AS DOUBLE)
                            - CAST(order_detail_std_price AS DOUBLE) * CAST(quantity AS DOUBLE)) <= 0.02
                  THEN 0 ELSE CAST(sale_money AS DOUBLE) END) AS ng,
         max(CAST(order_total_money AS DOUBLE)) AS tot,
         sum(CAST(order_detail_share_discount AS DOUBLE)) AS sd
  FROM "lguard"
  WHERE CAST(state AS VARCHAR) = 'FINISHED'
    AND CAST(order_transaction_type AS VARCHAR) = 'SALE_ORDER'
  GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT b AS branch_num,
       round(sum((ng + tot) / 2 - sd), 2) AS net,
       'lake' AS side
FROM per_order GROUP BY b ORDER BY b

data.label: pre 预聚合端点（branch 汇总）+ 原始报文落盘
pnormal 源侧行定型（对齐湖侧形状）

properties.sql:
SELECT CAST(branch_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_num,
       CAST(sale_money AS DOUBLE) AS net,
       'pre' AS side
FROM input

data.label: envelope 从原始报文抠网关 code（≠0 的行）

properties.sql:
SELECT CAST(code AS INTEGER) AS code, CAST(msg AS VARCHAR) AS msg
FROM read_json_auto('/workspace/reports/recon-preagg/raw-${ITER_ITEM_SYSTEM_BOOK}-${ITER_ITEM_BIZDAY}.json')
WHERE CAST(code AS INTEGER) <> 0

data.label: gcode 依赖闸：code≠0 即死（exit3 语义）

properties.message: recon 依赖不可用（pre_call）：预聚合端点返回非 0 code（{rows} 条）——bizday=${ITER_ITEM_BIZDAY}，修依赖不是查账

data.label: diff 逐店透视（任一侧缺=NULL）

properties.sql:
SELECT CAST(branch_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_num,
       max(CASE WHEN side = 'lake' THEN net END) AS net_lake,
       max(CASE WHEN side = 'pre' THEN net END) AS net_pre,
       round(max(CASE WHEN side = 'pre' THEN net END)
           - max(CASE WHEN side = 'lake' THEN net END), 2) AS diff
FROM input GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

data.label: vbranch 门店缺失违规行（未定稿恒空）

properties.sql:
SELECT branch_num, net_lake FROM input
WHERE net_pre IS NULL AND ${ITER_ITEM_SETTLED} = 1

data.label: gbranch 判据闸：湖有源无即死（exit1 语义）

properties.message: recon 判据破（branch_missing）：湖有而源无 {rows} 家——bizday=${ITER_ITEM_BIZDAY}

data.label: vthresh 容差违规（单行，未定稿恒空）

properties.sql:
WITH t AS (SELECT round(sum(net_lake), 2) AS lt, round(sum(net_pre), 2) AS pt FROM "diff"),
v AS (SELECT lt, pt, round(pt - lt, 2) AS diff,
      CASE WHEN pt > 0 THEN round((pt - lt) / pt * 100, 4) ELSE 0.0 END AS pct,
      round(greatest(1.00, abs(COALESCE(pt, 0)) * 0.0001), 2) AS tol
      FROM t)
SELECT lt, pt, diff, pct, tol FROM v
WHERE ${ITER_ITEM_SETTLED} = 1 AND abs(COALESCE(diff, 0)) > tol

data.label: gthresh 判据闸：差超容差即死（exit1 语义）

properties.message: recon 判据破（threshold）：总差超容差（bizday=${ITER_ITEM_BIZDAY}；违规行 {rows} 行，lt/pt/diff/pct/tol 数值见本 run 的 vthresh 节点输出与 reports/recon-preagg/*.csv）
